correctness.rationale: Contact saturation yields Ae_t=r(e_{t-1}+e_{t+1}); connectedness makes firing multiplicity equal for every vertex; integrality restricts temporal Fourier orders to 1,2,3,4,6; when 3∤|V| the period 12 case has three firings per vertex and zero primitive 12th Fourier coefficient, forcing four-periodicity. Every four-wave corresponds bijectively to one parity orientation and one signed adjacency-nullvector. Kneser odd-graph integrality is proved by a subset-incidence invariant filtration and the Lucas congruence explicitly. Exact finite checker output reproduces KG(7,3), Q4, K4,4, K5 and Lucas instances. No finite experiment is used as proof of an infinite theorem.

originality.rationale: Claim-level comparisons found no covering result. The prior integral-spectrum critical-contact bound permits 3-, 6- and 12-periods, while the new result removes every three-divisible period at graph orders coprime to three and determines exact four-cycle populations through binary zero eigenvectors.
